statement-processing.fact: Commission-report derives expected agent commission from the policy's own Commission Structure (captureAgentCommissionForPeriod reads the 'Commission V1 | M1-12' period card Agent split). A policy with only an Override rule (type 4) or no rule cannot be captured — GET /api/v1/policy/{uuid}/commissions returns {data:{}} or Override only. 7 CSV policies: Taynor/Riffett/Rodriguez have Commission rules; Dorothy/Kendra/Megan/Benjamin need one.
statement-processing.implication: HI-CR seed: POST /api/v1/policy/commission (array) with a Commission rule (type 1, Fixed Fee, feeAmount = CSV Commission $, M1-12 split 14/7/79/0; plus M13-No Limit 18/3/79/0). Detect via GET /commissions (ISO dates only). 400 POLICY_NUMBER_EXISTS on policy create = already seeded, verify not recreate. Do NOT weaken waitForHierarchySyncedToActivePeriod / stale-fingerprint (Agency 41 / Agent 55 under M1-12).

statement-processing.fact: PUT /api/v1/policy/commission/{ruleUuid} body: camelCase rule fields (policyUuid, ruleName, commissionType, paymentFrequency, monthFrom, monthTo, payoutMethod, feeAmount, premiumAmount, version) + commissionSplit[] with snake_case keys (order, role, user_name, user_uuid, user_code, commission_value, entity, level). POST /policy/commission takes an array for create. Response {data:{message,commissionUuid}}.
statement-processing.implication: Use exact wire format when seeding Commission rules via API; GET /policy/{uuid}/commissions returns camelCase (userName/commissionValue) — do not reuse GET casing for writes.
statement-processing.source: Policy seed session 2026-09-15 — live capture, PUT 200
